notes: Two branches joined by «ح»; the names after the second branch (يحيى, عبد الله بن أبي قتادة, أبي قتادة) are the shared tail, and branch one stops at هشام so the tail is added to it.
The dash gloss «قال ابن المثنى وأبي سلمة ثم اتفقا» names Abu Salama as a different transmitter in one version, so it is a variant group, not a route.
Editor glosses «- وهذا لفظه -» and Abu Dawud's remark on Musaddad's wording are left out.
